authority_boundary.statement: Passing means the named repository evidence is present, hashed, traceable and internally coherent. It is not a clause-by-clause conformity finding, certification, physical validation, permission to manufacture, construction release or permission to operate.

checks.title: Safety requirements and hazards remain traceable
Train separation and speed supervision remain independent of route selection
Network-loss routing fails restrictively on disagreement
Cabin and battery cooling allocation prioritises battery protection
Cross-domain FMEA has component, subsystem and system coverage
Civil structural screens retain survey and physical release boundaries
Recovery sidings, robots and single-track loops retain protected movement functions
Physical and independent-assessment gaps remain release-blocking
Consensus restart and infrastructure faults fail closed
Engineering benchmarks and interchange preserve units, CRS and identity
Promoted component RFCs retain traceable implementation and release gaps
Multi-day normal, peak, degraded and recovery profiles retain bounded logical state
Every controlled engineering and operational-platform item has a fail-closed assurance passport
BIM federation and IDS checks use current IFC4.3 lifecycle identities
Quality, lifecycle and laboratory evidence retain competence and approval boundaries

evidence_policy.change_rule: A changed requirement, design source, implementation, interface, environment, tool, evidence result, standard edition or condition of use reopens the affected control and every dependent decision.
evidence_policy.roll_up_rule: A parent control cannot close while a safety-significant child, interface, common-cause dependency, stale evidence item or required independent decision remains open.
